name: body-reps
summary: Count repetitions of a demonstrated exercise, punch or stroke (fitness, rope skipping, rowing, boxing) and compare each one's joint angles with the demonstration.

hardware.camera: a fixed camera that sees the whole body; the frame rate must exceed 2 x the fastest repetitions per second
hardware.compute: one pose model in its own environment

sota.summary: RTMW-l whole-body pose (COCO-WholeBody 70.1 AP), MediaPipe full when it cannot keep up (#373 rule)

ultralytics.summary: Ultralytics' combination: YOLO26-pose (17 COCO points), like its AIGym rep counting by joint angles

limits: one person is counted (the most visible); for an enrolled person use person-action-count; the form comparison is a joint-angle range, not a coach's judgement; Roboflow publishes no pose model, so this recipe has no roboflow stack
measured: the counter is person-action-count's (shotgun clip 16/16, docs/measurements/testbed-2026-11-26.md); the form comparison is not measured
